headline: Microsoft bets on local-AI PCs today, Gears of War: E-Day lands to strong reviews, and Antonelli takes an 84-point lead into F1's first Singapore sprint.

upcoming.what: Crew-12 splashdown off California (~07:34 Irish time) after undocking from the ISS Wednesday afternoon
F1 Singapore GP — Sprint Sat 11:00, Qualifying Sat 15:00, Race Sun 14:00 (Irish time)
UFC Fight Night: Allen vs Duncan — Apex, Las Vegas (main card 01:00 Sun Irish time)
Valor Mortis and Planet Zoo 2 release
UFC Fight Night: Buckley vs Malott — Edmonton, Canada
GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup finale — 3 Hours of Portimão

items.headline: Microsoft's local-AI PC event is today
items.summary: Nadella, Windows chief Pavan Davuluri and Nvidia's Jensen Huang take the stage in San Francisco later today. Expect pricing for the RTX Spark-powered Surface Laptop Ultra (up to 128GB unified memory) and a push on agentic AI built into Windows.

items.headline: OpenAI dumps 722 AI-written maths papers; mathematicians push back
items.summary: OpenAI's third maths release in nine weeks covers roughly 4,000 problems. Twenty-five Fields Medallists have signed a statement objecting less to the proofs than to the missing authorship, attribution and peer review.

items.headline: Anthropic offers startups a free year of Claude Team
items.summary: Announced at SF Tech Week, the expanded startup programme bundles up to five premium seats, $1,000 in API credits and office hours for young or recently funded companies. Separately, IPO chatter around Anthropic continues to build.

items.headline: India Mobile Congress opens with 6G front and centre
items.summary: The big telecoms show kicks off today in New Delhi, with 6G, AI in networks and cybersecurity leading the agenda. Worth a look for the networking side of things.

items.headline: Crew-12 heads home after eight months
items.summary: Meir, Hathaway, ESA's Sophie Adenot and Fedyaev undock from the ISS this afternoon (about 13:05 Irish time) and splash down off California early Thursday. Adenot became the first French woman to do a spacewalk during the mission.

items.headline: ESA–China SMILE mission sends first images
items.summary: The joint mission, built to watch how the solar wind batters Earth's magnetic shield, has finished commissioning and released its first ultraviolet and X-ray images. Science operations are now officially under way.

items.headline: A lunar pit that may lead into a giant cave
items.summary: NASA's GIMLI project plans to probe the Marius Hills pit with radar and seismic sensors to see whether it opens into a lava tube, a potential shelter for future crews.

items.headline: A 'jumping gene' at work in the human brain
items.summary: Researchers found the BC200 gene does a useful job in brain cells while keeping its ability to copy itself around the genome, an unusual combination.

items.headline: Gears of War: E-Day is out, and critics like it
items.summary: The Unreal Engine 5 prequel to Emergence Day launched on Xbox and PC yesterday, sitting around 88 on Metacritic. Praise centres on the combat; the open-world stretches and boss fights get the most criticism.

items.headline: Witcher 3 Remastered gets a Cyberpunk 2077 crossover
items.summary: Own both games on the same platform with a linked CDPR account and you can pick up a Wolf bandana and the Rabble-Rouser hairstyle for Geralt from a chest in Vizima's Royal Palace. Still nothing new on Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2 or Borderlands 4 since yesterday.

items.headline: Rest of the week: Dragon's Dogma 2 expansion, Hellraiser, Kingdom Hearts
items.summary: Thursday brings Dragon's Dogma II's Dark Arisen expansion (set in the Snowy North), Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival on PC and the Kingdom Hearts I–III collection.

items.headline: Jaworski doubles up at No-Gi Pans
items.summary: Fresh off ADCC gold, Paweł Jaworski won both -85kg and the absolute at the IBJJF Pan No-Gi in New Jersey. Sarah Galvão also took double gold, Helena Crevar won heavyweight, and Emilio Hernandez finally landed a major title.

items.headline: André Galvão, 44, back on an IBJJF podium
items.summary: Galvão won two matches to reach the super-heavyweight final, then closed out the division with Atos teammate Natã Tenca, who took gold after heel-hook and footlock finishes on the way.

items.headline: José Aldo vs Marlon Vera grappling match ends in a draw
items.summary: The old UFC rivals went 10 submission-only minutes in Quito at the weekend with no finish; Vera pushed for takedowns early and later threatened a heel hook that Aldo escaped.

items.headline: UFC 332 catch-up: Natália Silva is flyweight champion
items.summary: Silva beat Wang Cong on a unanimous decision on Saturday for the title Shevchenko vacated. The card set UFC records for knockdowns, knockouts and first-round KOs; Payton Talbott stopped Deiveson Figueiredo in round one.

items.headline: Fight week: Allen vs Duncan on Saturday
items.summary: England's Christian Leroy Duncan gets his first main event against Brendan Allen at the Apex, with fellow Englishman Jai Herbert in the co-main. Main card starts around 01:00 Sunday Irish time.

items.headline: The road to Volkanovski vs Evloev
items.summary: After Vegas comes Buckley vs Malott in Edmonton (17 Oct), then UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi on 24 Oct with Volkanovski vs Evloev on top.

items.headline: Antonelli 84 points clear heading to Singapore
items.summary: Russell's power-unit failure at Sepang turned a 66-point gap into 84 with seven rounds left, and a new engine means he's expected to start Sunday from the back. Mercedes' new aero package also struggled in slow corners, which is a worry for Marina Bay.

items.headline: First Singapore sprint, one practice hour
items.summary: Teams get a single FP1 (10:30 Fri Irish time) before parc fermé. Verstappen, fresh from Red Bull-Ford's first win as a works team, has never won in Singapore. Forecast is hot and mostly dry.

items.headline: WEC: Toyota edged Alpine at Fuji
items.summary: Catching up from 27 Sept: the #8 Toyota of Buemi, Hartley and Hirakawa won by 0.6s after gambling on track position under a late safety car. WRT's BMW took LMGT3 with a last-lap pass by Farfus. GTWC's Portimão finale follows on 17–18 Oct.
